entries.note: Wilhelm 2011 (PMID 21170960, epub 2011-04-22) resolves; Gadomer/GS9L sentence verbatim in abstract. Opening untested entry at first publication is correct.

Mross 2012 (PMID 22421192) resolves; quote verbatim. DCE-MRI perfusion fell in mixed solid-tumour phase 1 (healthy/other patients allowed for engagement). Direction only, downstream tier, paired: correct.
Quote verbatim in Wilhelm 2011 abstract. Grep of regorafenib PharmR for an efficacious/minimum effective exposure found none; doses set by phase 1 MTD, so untested/no_prediction is right.
786-O shrinkage sentence verbatim. Trial NCT00664326 ran April 2008-June 2011; xenograft data published before its 2012 report, so the opening entry is sound.
Eisen 2012 (PMID 22959186, epub 2012-09-06) quote verbatim; ORR is the stated primary. Registry results first posted 2012-11-28 confirmed via CT.gov API; year 2012 correct.
Matsuki 2017 (PMID 28107584) quote verbatim; abstract opens from the phase II result, so retrodiction/retro and comparison_stated true hold. See rule question on retro after same on one track.
Du 2022 (PMID 35222406) quote verbatim; abstract cites anlotinib's patient efficacy first, so retro is right. Zhou 2019 patient quote verbatim. Catequentinib is AL3818 (anlotinib), so it is a member.

Quote verbatim in bundled 203085 PharmR; next sentence notes liver enzyme elevations seen clinically. Imported from CRC flagged. Track has no opening untested entry at 2008 (rule 6), lint did not flag.

Model sentence ('Lenvatinib induced renal toxicity in rats and monkeys, including proteinuria') verbatim in bundled 206947 PharmR (Feb 2015); Motzer 2015 quote verbatim; registry 2019-02-27 confirmed. Pairing sound; no opening untested entry.

Yamamoto 2014 (PMID 25197551, epub 2014-09-06) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract conclusion. Patient-selection prediction not known from patients at the time, so opening untested at 2014, prediction_level patient, correct.

entries.rule: same/contra from a pairing whose trial source attributes the result to conditions the model never tested -> untested; latest untested carries untested_reason (not_measured)
entries.note: CLEAR biomarker paper (PMID 39672382) quote verbatim. Model predicted IHC vascular score (MVD + pericyte coverage) for lenvatinib alone; patient readout is an RNA MVD signature in the lenvatinib+pembrolizumab arm. Readout never measured; set untested, untested_reason not_measured.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 5 not_measured: the model's IHC vascular score (MVD plus pericyte coverage, lenvatinib alone) was never measured; CLEAR measured an RNA MVD signature in the lenvatinib-pembrolizumab arm. No admissible contra pairing.

entries.rule: Dating rule 6: each cell opens at model_first_use_year
entries.note: Kato 2019 (PMID 30811474) quote verbatim. Same Eisai syngeneic system (Hepa1-6, lenvatinib plus anti-PD-1) was first published in Kimura 2018 Cancer Sci (doi:10.1111/cas.13806, epub 2018-11-16); opening entry and model_first_use_year should be 2018.
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed (opening entry, rule 6). Checker right on dating: Kimura 2018 Cancer Sci (doi:10.1111/cas.13806, online 2018-11-16) ran lenvatinib plus anti-PD-1 in Hepa1-6, so opening year and model_first_use_year should be 2018.

entries.note: Motzer 2021 (PMID 33616314, epub 2021-02-13) quote verbatim; its background states the combination already had RCC activity (KEYNOTE-146 reports from 2016-17), before Kimura 2018/Kato 2019, so retro is right. Direction only vs sunitinib.

entries.rule: year = first public date of the model-patient comparison
entries.note: Field year: 2017 -> 2016. Lenvima label revised 05/2016 (206947s003lbl.pdf) sec 12.1 states lenvatinib+everolimus beat each drug alone in RCC xenografts verbatim, and sec 14 carries Study 2 (205) RCC results. Status stays retro; src could move to label (tier 2).
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed (retro, retrodiction rule). Checker right on dating (rule 6): Lenvima label revised 05/2016 (206947s003, verified) sec 12.1 states the RCC xenograft combination result beside Study 205 in sec 14, so year 2016.

missing: Yamamoto 2014 Vascular Cell (doi:10.1186/2045-824X-6-18, PMID 25197551): lenvatinib 19-model xenograft panel with a vascular-score (MVD + pericyte coverage) sensitivity biomarker; kidney cancer had the highest MVD/vascular score in human specimens. A patient-level prediction track for lenvatinib, likely untested (not_measured) in RCC; published after Study 205's ASCO 2014 readout.

FDA review of the lenvatinib RCC supplement (NDA 206947 S-007, 2016) and the 2016 label section 12/13 stating lenvatinib+everolimus exceeded either drug in RCC xenografts: not in the bundle; a regulator source that could date the lenvatinib RCC-xenograft retrodiction to 2016 rather than 2017.

Xie 2018 Cancer Sci (doi:10.1111/cas.13536): anlotinib preclinical characterization with in-vivo xenografts, published before the RCC phase II paper (2019); check whether a renal xenograft was included, which would give anlotinib a prospective model.

Famitinib RCC patient data: phase II NCT01829841 (started 2011-05, no results posted) and camrelizumab+famitinib RCC cohort (Qu 2021 Clin Cancer Res, doi:10.1158/1078-0432.ccr-21-1698). Only famitinib model found is gastric BGC-823 xenograft (doi:10.3892/ol.2016.4909), not RCC; draft's 'no famitinib RCC model' stands.
rule_questions: A retrodiction (efficacy 3, retro 2017) on a track whose prior prospective entry is same (2012): should the track's latest status become retro, hiding the prospective match, or should retro entries not change a track's displayed status once it has a prospective same?

Rule 6 says each cell opens at model_first_use_year with untested; the two safety tracks open directly at same with model_first_use_year 2008/2010. Is an opening untested entry required per track, and should lint enforce it?

Lenvatinib (Study 205) is listed as a patient_trial on the regorafenib 786-O track and lenvatinib's own xenografts share that model_id: is 'nude-mouse RCC cell-line xenograft' one system across sponsors and cell lines (786-O vs A-498/Caki), or one track per member drug?

Patient-level (biomarker) track paired with a combination arm and a different assay of the same biological variable (RNA MVD signature vs IHC vascular score): the rules do not say whether that is a different readout (untested/not_measured) or an admissible contra at low confidence.
